description: This source file defines the interface 'DaemonTokenAware' in the org.openmrs.module package, specifying a method for setting a daemon token to enable daemon user operations.

classes.name: DaemonTokenAware
classes.description: An interface for classes that need to receive a daemon token to perform actions as the daemon user.

methods.name: setDaemonToken
methods.description: Method to receive and set the daemon token, potentially called by multiple threads. The last token set is considered valid.
